text:
ashwin: FYI kicking off a late-ingest sweep for events dated 2026-02-20..2026-02-26. We saw a burst of delayed Kinesis deliveries and some partial parquets. Goal: recompute aggregates + repair missing KV cache keys.

maria: +1. Do we have the final list of affected partitions? I can map to dashboards to mark as stale.

ashwin: I ran a scan last night. Short list attached below (s3 prefixes). Planning to run in slices by org_id to avoid cross-tenant IO spikes.

eli: Important: metric windows use a rolling 5m window with boundary alignment on UTC. Backfills must re-run the same windowing logic or we'll misalign counts.

james: How are we handling routing to Dedicated vs Hosted compute? We should prefer cheaper idle dedicated nodes but keep a fallback to Hosted so we don't stall.

ashwin: Good call. Plan: primary job queue -> dedicated-pool (low concurrency), fallback -> hosted-burst. We'll add a job tag so Console can show which pool ran it.

sara: For dashboard UX: add a 'recompute in progress' flag and display the reprocessed watermark per chart. Otherwise PMs will think data regressed.

maria: I'll add a small banner on the affected dashboard pages. Also need an annotation on the timeline at the exact last_event_ts we processed.

ashwin: Implementation notes:
```bash
# example batch invocation
./backfill --s3-prefix s3://redwood-telemetry/ingest/late/2026-02-20 --shard org=123 --window-align utc --dest=parquet-repaired
```
We will run with --dry-run first, then enable --commit.

eli: Make sure the KV cache invalidation happens after the parquet rewrite. We should emit an event to cache-invalidator service with the list of keys. Something like:
```json
{"type":"recompute_complete","org_id":123,"ranges":["2026-02-20T00:00","2026-02-26T23:59"]}
```
We'll also throttle invalidation RPCs to avoid stampeding our caches.

james: Any SLA concerns? If this spikes tokens or runaway CPU we need a kill switch. Add a circuit breaker in the orchestrator.

ashwin: Agreed — orchestrator will have per-org rate and global fail-open timeout. If >70% CPU for 10m we pause and notify #eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job backfill-late-ingest-1769456123 queued on dedicated-pool (concurrency=4). Logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/backfills/1769456123

maria: I pushed a small frontend pr to show the recompute banner and watermark. Preview: https://staging.console/redwood/dashboards/preview/late-backfill-1769456123

ashwin: Running dry-run slice 0 now, watching IO and parsing errors. Will post a short summary in 30m. Thanks all. :rocket:
